TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka tou æ̈ugh ki ninnum ki wæ'i ni-pa-toulam ta ti Jesus tyni-æn ti Petrus-an, ti Jakobus-an, ti Joannes-an-appa, ka ni-dyllough tyn pou-nni neini-æn tou voukkyn ka mahandagh.
S.TRANSL: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗地上了高山，

S.FORM: Ka ni-silala ta hauwei tyn tou æmæh neini-æn: ka ni-matyk-kanagh ta vlung tyn mama ki wæ'i, ka ni-myh-poule ta pammien tyn mama ki ramæh.
S.TRANSL: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytta-ei, ka ni-kytt'an nein ta ti Moses, ti Elias-appa mattæ'i-tævægh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta ti Petrus k'ma ti Jesus-an, Mæirang, mariang ta æia-koua'n-eta hiä, heirou mamoei-kow, nda meiringei-eta hia toutouro ki ratta, âmmouhou-a ta sasat, â Moses-a ta sasat, â Elias-a ta sasat.
S.TRANSL: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
彼得對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裏真好！你若願意，我就在這裏搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」

S.FORM: Tou pasousou-en-appa tyn, k'ytt'ei, ta pourarei ka maræmæh ka ni-tma mourrap neini-æn. Ka kytt'ei ta yngau ka makka pourarei, koun, Ti atta ta Alak au ka kavæ'ango-en-au ka kamau-en-au ta teni, millingigh-â tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！」

S.FORM: Ka rou illing-hen [ta atta] ki Pahtatæutæu-han, ni-dmangus ki vlung nein, ka ouhang ta neni ki tahkout.
S.TRANSL: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
門徒聽見，就俯伏在地，極其害怕。

S.FORM: Irou ka irou'-ato ta ti Jesus, ni-smoukla neini-æn, koun, 'Æhpitt-â, ynna mahtakout.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：「起來，不要害怕！」

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-papassau-vavau ki matta nein, assi nein ni-kyttan ta sasasat ka timamang, dyk ti Jesus-an ka itou-saät.
S.TRANSL: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裏。

S.FORM: Irou ka tddarim ta neni tou voukkyn, ni-sikidi neini-æn ta ti Jesus, koun, Ynna bana vana ki saäat ki vouel ki ky-hau-ei-en [k'atta,] tou kidi-appa ka æh-pit-al-ato ta Alak ki kaæuloung ki ni-kapatei-an tyn.
S.TRANSL: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-tmaligh tyni-æn ta Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, k'ma, Mang koun ki Makou-sasoulat, ka kidi-ato ka siouro-ah iroua ta ti Elias?
S.TRANSL: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
門徒問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus k'ma neini-æn: Siouro-ah iroua ta ti Elias, ka pæ-likoug-ah pæ-æhpit ki mamang.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
耶穌回答說：「以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；

S.FORM: Râ pasousou-en-au-kamou, ka mah-kah'ato iroua ta ti Elias, ka assi nein ni-kalangin tyni-æn: râ ni-pam't-en nein tyni-æn ta mamang ka ni-kamoei-in nein. Kma-appa-hynna papæ'i-alalam-ei nein ta Alak ki ka'æuloung.
S.TRANSL: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-oumhan ki Pahtatæutæu-han ka ni-mattæi-mymmia neini-æn ti Joannes-an ka na Tama-æulough.
S.TRANSL: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指着施洗的約翰。

S.FORM: Ka tou oukakoun nein tou makoi-lalaulau, ni-iroua tyni-an ta sât ki voual, ka matta-likourough tou douma tyni-an, ni-k'ma.
S.TRANSL: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裏，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，

S.FORM: Meirang, kaharum-au ta alak-au, ka pis-bouravourel pis-koupang mapatei, ka pæ'i-lalouaf pæ'i-alalam: ka vounavounei mouaring tou opoei, vounavounei-appa tou raloum.
S.TRANSL: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
說：「主啊，憐憫我的兒子！他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裏，屢次跌在水裏。

S.FORM: Ka ni-ad-au ta teni pa-ouqua tou Pahtatæutæu-en-hou, ka assi nein pa-lpoughin tyni-æn padarikægh.
S.TRANSL: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
我帶他到你門徒那裏，他們卻不能醫治他。」

S.FORM: Ka rou mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus, ni-koun tyn, A-lei-ah ki kavavouyl-an ka assi tna-msing ka maparit, makka mang-ah koh ki dâllia ka toulam-ah-koh ymoumi-æn? Makka mang-ah ki dallia ka tub'h-ei-mau-kamou? ad-auto hia ta teni paou-qua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-matymha tyni-æn ta ti Jesus, ka ni-d'marang ta Lyttou tyni-æn, ka pædærikæh-ato ta rauwei tou patou-kidi-en k'anna ki tæ'lei-râ.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊癒了。

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna rou ni-hmani iroua ti Jesus-an ta Pahtatæutæuhan, ka ni-koun nein, Kaumang ka assi-kame ta ymi-an ni-smaki-lpough samki-pæpænæh tyni-æn?
S.TRANSL: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
門徒暗暗地到耶穌跟前，說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Alei ki kaurou-an-noumi tnamsing: d'lligh koun-nau-kamou-râ, irou na hei mamâma ki touhto ki shai ta tna-msing-an-noumi, ynna-kamou bana-vana ki voukkyn k'atta, d'marang-â hia mou-koua hynna, ka d'marang-ah mou-koua: ka aousi-al-ato kimamang ka assi-moumi ynanang-ei mei-lpough.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
耶穌說：「是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：『你從這邊挪到那邊』，它也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。

S.FORM: Râ kidi ki nanang k'atta assi padarang-in, dyk ki pako Alilid-den ki i-rikht-en appa.
S.TRANSL: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來 。」

S.FORM: Tou hi-kakou-'an nein [mou-naunang] tou Galileä, ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-eih ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou rima ki ka'æuloung.
S.TRANSL: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：「人子將要被交在人手裏。

S.FORM: Ka pakapatei-ah tyni-æn, ka papatti-mæuæ-auh tou katatouro ki wæ'i. Ka ouhang mivoulas ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。」門徒就大大地憂愁。

S.FORM: Ka tou ou-kakoun nein tou Kapernaum, ni-mou-koua ti Petrus-an ta Tama-jmuh ki Di-draghma, ka ni-k'ma, Assi kaua poudaæuh ki Di-dragh-ma ta Tama Mahtæutæuuh ymoumi-æn?
S.TRANSL: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：「你們的先生不納丁稅嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-koun tyn, Hahei. Ka rou ni-mou-rbo tou tallagh, ni-mæ-æuro masousou tyni-æn ta ti Jesus, ka ni-koun tyn, Pæh-mang kow pæh-dimdim Simon? Mara na mang-an ta si-bavau Mei-sasou ki Næi ki pouh-tanang-en pou-daæugh ki 'a-ymh'-an lava? Ki Alalak nein kaua? ki rarouma kaua?
S.TRANSL: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
彼得說：「納。」他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：「西門，你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰征收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Petrus tyni-æn, Ki rarouma. Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Anna ta tæ'æ̈-nynno ta Alalak assi pou-daæuh.
S.TRANSL: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
彼得說：「是向外人。」耶穌說：「既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。

S.FORM: Râ alei ka assi-mytta pasai-sala-kouap ta neni, mou-vaoung-â, pa-heiriryng-an-ei ta heiryng, ka arau ta t'hing ka mououro mou-vavau, ka rou tiaf-au ta moutous tyn, ka-balei-au-mhou ta Stater [ka malitouk:] arau ta anna, ka p'hæan-ei'to neini-æn alei jau-an, alei-appa ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
但恐怕觸犯他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了牠的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。」
